intended_object: A map f : M → M' between manifolds with corners is differentiable on a set s if, at every point x of s, f is differentiable within s at x. This comes from the docstring, which describes it as the manifold version of `DifferentiableOn`.
explanation: This is Mathlib's own definition. The body says `∀ x ∈ s, MDifferentiableWithinAt I I' f s x`, which is the standard pointwise definition, built the same way as `DifferentiableOn` (`∀ x ∈ s, DifferentiableWithinAt 𝕜 f s x`). It is stated in full generality: any nontrivially normed field, any manifolds with corners modeled on normed spaces, and any set s. Nothing extra or missing.
